title: Better Telegram Search v0.7.4
notes:
### What's new

- **Whole-message noise filtering.** Short multiword messages and bot commands now appear alongside single-word reactions, with statistics and typo families.
- **Review entire families.** Expand a family, browse its variants and choose which exact messages to keep or omit. Choices survive paging and collapsing; save and preview the rules before applying them.
- **Clear analysis completion.** Finished scans with individual size or hypothesis limits are shown as completed reports with limits, rather than appearing stuck at the last message count.

Run a new noise analysis to include whole-message families. Existing archives, models and indexed progress are preserved. Applying changed rules rebuilds only the selected dialog's text index.
